name: toolmgr
description: AitoolMgr — AI programming tool & OpenClaw Agent monitoring command center

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aitoolmgr/contracts && npm run build -w @aitoolmgr/adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @toolmgr/core && npm run build -w @toolmgr/notify-feishu && npm run build -w @toolmgr/adapters && npm run build -w @toolmgr/agent && npm run build -w @toolmgr/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @aitoolmgr/contracts && npm run test -w @aitoolmgr/contracts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aitoolmgr/contracts && npm run build -w @aitoolmgr/adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @toolmgr/core && npm run build -w @toolmgr/notify-feishu && npm run build -w @toolmgr/adapters && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @toolmgr/agent" "npm run dev -w @toolmgr/desktop"
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run pack:win -w @toolmgr/desktop
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run pack:mac -w @toolmgr/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @toolmgr/core && npm run typecheck -w @toolmgr/adapters && npm run typecheck -w @toolmgr/agent && npm run typecheck -w @toolmgr/desktop
